Şebnem.definition:
The most [perfect person] in [the world]. They're usually shy and cute, but they also have a charming side. They are smart and strong women. They can do unexpected things when you least expect it. They usually like art, science. If you become friends with someone named Şebnem, don't leave them. [Love them].
(It also means dew)

Şamil.definition: Şamil is tall and thin. He makes [people] relax and them laugh. He has a tall and [charismatic] stance. He does not know and cannot learn very simple [things].

Şükrü.definition: The person with this name will be very rich, lucky, happy and sexy at [the same] time. It is a religous turkish name what brings [your life] safety. [Everyone] needs a şükrü for herself!

Şuara.definition: Şuara is such a girl who is loved by everyone. Her smile is like sunshine and when she smiles you can see how beautiful she is. Her hair is like a road to heaven and her existence is a gift from the god. Şuara will make a great friend and if you want her help, she'd love to advice you and help you make a choice. Even though you upset her, if you show her you love her, she would be the [best friend] you'd ever had. She's kind and fun to talk with. Even though [you're not] next to her, you can feel her warmth in [your heart]. When she's mad she's cute, but be cautious not to lose her. If you lose her it's hard to get her back. She is a jewel that is hard to find. Everybody needs Şuara in their life, but some get it.
